facts.fact: Ethan 做了怪梦：从没见过的桥上慢镜头坠海、越沉越深，惊醒时像被不存在的水呛住——与 Maddox 的溺水遥相呼应。
facts.anchor: From some sort of bridge I’d never seen, I’d been falling toward water

facts.fact: 五个孩子同晚都梦见灰山羊胡的斗篷男撑着木船——摆渡人意象进入 Misfits 的集体梦。
facts.anchor: And a cloaked man, but all we could see was his grey goatee

facts.fact: Ethan 查房时听见 Sebastian 睡梦中念出「Zero-four-nine-nine」——正是东线安全屋的门锁密码。
Finn 不在自己房间，被发现在 Johnny 的床上睡去——空床之痛蔓延。
facts.anchor: I made my way up to find Finn sleeping in Johnny’s bed

facts.fact: Ethan 的火场往事：纵火的是父亲，妹妹死于那场火，被虐者却主动背下半生罪责。
facts.anchor: I hadn’t set fire to the house, yet my sister’s death was mine to own

facts.fact: Sarah 抚着 Ethan 疤痕的脸轻声说：你永远无法让我相信她的死是你的错。
facts.anchor: “You will never convince me her death is your fault.”

facts.fact: Sarah 突然告白「I have loved you for so long」并强吻，咬向他的颈——Ethan 断片，两人随即牙齿剧痛双双滚落。
facts.anchor: When she started to bite my neck? Blackout.

facts.fact: 走廊上 Gage、Finn、Sebastian 全都捂着嘴含混喊「Mad G!」——血誓众人牙齿同时剧痛；Harmony 要送急诊，众人怕抽血变实验品尖叫拒绝。
facts.anchor: Next to him were Finn and Sebastian. All holding their mouths.
